sources.claim_in_original: Nosso projeto adota o padrão Router-Controller-Service-Repository...
sources.claim_source_status: Original project wiki currently remains unverified per migration/evidence/references/ages-i.json.
sources.verification_question: Is there official primary documentation that directly names or defines this combined Router-Controller-Service-Repository pattern?

queries: site:expressjs.com routing controllers services repository architecture
site:learn.microsoft.com architecture repository pattern service layer controller routing

partial_match_reviewed.title: Validating with a Service Layer (C#)
partial_match_reviewed.evidence: The Microsoft Learn article describes a service layer, a repository layer, and controllers using the repository layer.
partial_match_reviewed.limitation: It is a legacy ASP.NET MVC tutorial and does not define the combined Router-Controller-Service-Repository pattern or a Router layer.

partial_match_reviewed.title: Common web application architectures
partial_match_reviewed.evidence: Official .NET architecture documentation discusses controllers, services, and the Repository pattern.
partial_match_reviewed.limitation: It does not establish the exact combined label and does not document the AGES I project architecture.

official_source_search.result: No single official source directly matching the combined label was verified; component-level documentation is not evidence that AGES I implemented this exact pattern.

sources.integration_recommendation: Preserve the original wording and URL. Do not invent a citation or relabel the architecture. A project wiki export, source-code evidence, or explicit human-provided documentation may resolve the project-specific architecture; those would not substitute for a verified general pattern source unless the intended claim is changed in a later editorial phase.

official_source.title: RFC 9110: HTTP Semantics
official_source.publisher_or_series: Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) RFC Series / RFC Editor
official_source.direct_support: RFC 9110 defines HTTP semantics and sections 9.3.1, 9.3.3, 9.3.4, and 9.3.5 define GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE.
official_source.limitation: Supports the protocol and method names, not the AGES II endpoint implementation or observed request behavior.

sources.year_convention_note: The publication date 2022 is explicitly verified for RFC 9110. If the user-authorized 2024 citation-year convention is applied to this item, record 2024 as an assigned convention, not as publication metadata.

sources.term: SQL in queries sent to PostgreSQL

official_source.title: Part II. The SQL Language
official_source.direct_support: The page says this part describes use of SQL in PostgreSQL, including syntax, commands, data definition, data manipulation, and queries.
official_source.limitation: Current documentation is not evidence that the project used PostgreSQL 18 or consulted this page during 2024.

sources.integration_recommendation: The existing PostgreSQL documentation reference may be sufficient as the target for the SQL mention if the maintainer links that term to the already verified PostgreSQL entry; do not infer a separate SQL author or standard.

official_source.title: RFC 8259: The JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) Data Interchange Format
official_source.publisher_or_series: Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) RFC Series / RFC Editor
official_source.direct_support: RFC 8259 defines JSON as a text-based data-interchange format and specifies its representation rules.
official_source.limitation: Supports the generic format term, not the AGES II application's actual response payloads.

sources.year_convention_note: The publication date 2017 is explicitly verified for RFC 8259. If the user-authorized 2024 citation-year convention is applied to this item, record 2024 as an assigned convention, not as publication metadata.

global_integration_notes: Figma and Excalidraw can be sourced with title-based citations because the official current pages do not explicitly attribute an individual author; do not assign Figma or Excalidraw community as author solely from branding/copyright.
For Excalidraw, choose deliberately between the original product homepage reference and the developer-docs page; the latter's displayed page heading is generic (Introduction).

AGES II's 'Documentação Docker' prose label has no inline href in the ODT, but it maps to the original bibliography reference ages-ii-docker at https://www.docker.com/ (manifest text-p-1574 and text-a-0171; direct content.xml check). This preserves the user's source. The homepage is not technical documentation, so technical support remains PENDING; the docs.docker.com portal is not selected and must not replace it.

HTTP and JSON have directly matching IETF RFC sources; SQL has a directly matching PostgreSQL documentation section for SQL in PostgreSQL. These sources support technical definitions only, not project-specific implementation claims.
The exact Router-Controller-Service-Repository label has no verified direct official source in the search performed; keep it PENDING and do not invent authorship.
